privacy.title: Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo
privacy.description: Indlela I Need Convert ephatha ngayo idatha namafayela akho. Amafayela aguqulwa kusiphequluli sakho futhi awalayishwa neze kumaseva ethu.
privacy.body:
I Need Convert (ineedconvert.com) yithuluzi lamahhala lokuguqula izithombe, amavidiyo, umsindo, amadokhumenti, ama-PDF, ama-spreadsheet nedatha, eliphethwe ngu-Abid Hanan Wicaksono. Le nqubomgomo ichaza ukuthi iyiphi idatha ecutshungulwayo uma usebenzisa le webhusayithi nokuthi siyiphatha kanjani. Ngamabomu siqoqa idatha encane ngangokunokwenzeka: awudingi ukubhalisa, ukungena ngemvume, noma ukunikeza igama lakho ne-imeyili ukuze usebenzise le sevisi.

Amafayela owaguqulayo

Konke ukuguqula kwenzeka ngqo kusiphequluli sakho. Amafayela owakhethayo afundwa futhi acutshungulwe yidivayisi yakho uqobo, bese imiphumela igcinwa ngqo kudivayisi yakho. Amafayela akho nokuqukethwe kwawo awalayishwa neze kumaseva ethu, asiwagcini, futhi asikwazi ukuwabona. Uma uvala noma ulayisha kabusha ikhasi, lawo mafayela ayasuka enkumbulweni yesiphequluli.

Idatha esiyicubungulayo

  • Idatha yezobuchwepheshe. Njengecishe zonke izingosi zewebhu, umhlinzeki wethu we-hosting (Cloudflare) urekhoda idatha yezobuchwepheshe yezicelo, njengekheli le-IP, uhlobo lwesiphequluli nesikhathi sokufinyelela, ngenxa yokuphepha nokusebenza. Lawa marekhodi agcinwa okwesikhashana kuphela ngokwenqubomgomo ye-Cloudflare.
  • Izibalo zezindatshana. Inani lokubukwa, lokuthandwa nokwabiwa ligcinwa njengesamba sendatshana ngayinye, ngaphandle kwanoma iyiphi imininingwane ekuhlonzayo.

Amakhukhi nokugcinwa kusiphequluli

  • inc-lang (localStorage): ikhumbula ulimi olukhethile. Le datha ihlala kudivayisi yakho.
  • Amakhukhi okuhlaziya eqembu lesithathu avela ku-Google Analytics naku-Microsoft Clarity, achazwe ngezansi.
  • Isitoreji sendawo (localStorage ne-sessionStorage): sikhumbula izindatshana ozithandile futhi sivimbela ukuthi ukuvakasha okukodwa kubalwe kabili. Le mininingwane ihlala kudivayisi yakho.

Ukuhlaziya

Sisebenzisa amathuluzi okuhlaziya ukuze siqonde ukuthi iwebhusayithi isetshenziswa kanjani futhi siyithuthukise:

  • Google Analytics 4 (Google LLC): isebenzisa amakhukhi ukukala amakhasi owavulayo, izwe okulo ngokulinganiselwa, uhlobo lwedivayisi yakho, nezehlakalo ezifana nokuchofoza izinkinobho zokulanda. Imininingwane icutshungulwa yi-Google ngaphansi kweNqubomgomo Yobumfihlo ye-Google.
  • Microsoft Clarity: ilayishwa lapho nje uqala ukusebenzisana nekhasi. I-Clarity irekhoda ukusebenzisana okufana nokuchofoza nokuskrola ukuze kwenziwe ama-heatmap nokuqoshwa kwamaseshini, futhi ifihla lokho okuthayipha ezindaweni zokufaka umbhalo. Imininingwane icutshungulwa yi-Microsoft ngaphansi kweSitatimende Sobumfihlo se-Microsoft.

Ungaphuma ekuhlaziyeni ngokuvimba amakhukhi eqembu lesithathu kuzilungiselelo zesiphequluli sakho, ngokusebenzisa isivimbi sokulandelela (tracker blocker), noma ngokufaka i-Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on. Iwebhusayithi isasebenziseka ngokugcwele.

Amasevisi ezinkampani zangaphandle

  • Cloudflare, Inc. ihlinzeka nge-hosting. Amaseva ayo angase abe ngaphandle kwe-Indonesia.
  • jsDelivr ihlinzeka ngenjini yokuguqula amavidiyo nomsindo. Le njini ilandelwa kusiphequluli sakho okokuqala uma uguqula ividiyo noma umsindo, ngakho ikheli lakho le-IP liyabonakala ku-jsDelivr. Amafayela akho awathunyelwa.
  • Google Fonts isetshenziselwa ukubonisa ezinye izinhlamvu zokubhala (isibonelo, isi-Arabhu, isi-Thai, noma isi-Japanese). Uma amafonti elayishwa, ikheli lakho le-IP liyabonakala ku-Google.
  • Izinkinobho zokwabelana (WhatsApp, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Telegram) zixhumana nalawo masevisi kuphela uma uzichofoza.

Ukuphepha nokwabelana ngedatha

Konke ukuxhumana nale webhusayithi kusebenzisa i-HTTPS. Asidayisi, asiqashisi, futhi asihwebi ngedatha yomuntu siqu. Idatha yabelwana kuphela nabahlinzeki besevisi abashiwo ngenhla ngezinga elidingekayo ukuze kuqhutshwe iwebhusayithi, noma uma kudingwa ngumthetho.

Izingane

Le sevisi ayihloselwe izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-13, futhi asiqoqi ngamabomu idatha yomuntu siqu yezingane.

Amalungelo akho

Ngokomthetho wase-Indonesia No. 27 wango-2022 Wokuvikelwa Kwedatha Yomuntu Siqu, unelungelo lokucela ukufinyelela, ukulungiswa, noma ukususwa kwedatha yakho yomuntu siqu, kanye nokuhoxisa imvume yokuthi icutshungulwe. Njengoba cishe singayigcini idatha ekuhlonzayo, iningi lezicelo lingaxazululwa ngokususa idatha yesayithi kuzilungiselelo zesiphequluli sakho. Ngezinye izicelo, xhumana nathi.

Izinguquko kule nqubomgomo

Le nqubomgomo ingabuyekezwa noma nini. Izinguquko ziqala ukusebenza lapho zishicilelwa kuleli khasi, kanti usuku lokuqala ukusebenza lukhonjiswa phezulu.

Xhumana nathi

Imibuzo ngale nqubomgomo ingathunyelwa ngesixhumanisi sokuxhumana esingezansi kwekhasi ngalinye noma nge-abidhanan.my.id.
terms.title: Imigomo & Imibandela
terms.description: Imigomo nemibandela yokusebenzisa i-I Need Convert, ithuluzi lamahhala lokuguqula amafayela kusiphequluli.
terms.body:
Ngokusebenzisa i-I Need Convert (ineedconvert.com), uyavumelana nale migomo nemibandela elandelayo. Uma ungavumelani nayo, sicela ungayisebenzisi le sevisi.

Mayelana nesevisi

I Need Convert yithuluzi lamahhala lokushintsha amafayela asuke kwifomethi eyodwa aye kwenye. Ukuguqula kwenzeka kusiphequluli sakho, ngakho amafayela awalayishwa kumaseva ethu. I Need Convert ayixhumene, ayisekelwa, futhi ayisebenzisani ne-Apple, i-Microsoft, i-Google, i-Adobe, noma yimuphi omunye umnikazi wefomethi noma wophawu. Zonke izimpawu zokuhweba ngezabanikazi bazo.

Ukusetshenziswa okuvunyelwe

  • Guqula kuphela amafayela angawakho, onemvume yokuwasebenzisa, noma avunyelwe ukusetshenziswa ngokomthetho osebenzayo.
  • Ungasebenzisa le sevisi ngezizathu zakho siqu noma zomsebenzi, inqobo nje uma uhambisana nale migomo.

Amafayela akho nomthwalo wakho

Amafayela owaguqulayo ahlala engawakho noma awomnikazi wamalungelo awo. Unomthwalo ogcwele wamafayela owakhethayo nendlela osebenzisa ngayo imiphumela eguquliwe. Njalo gcina ikhophi yefayela lokuqala ngaphambi kokuguqula.

Okungavunyelwe

  • Ukuguqula noma ukusabalalisa okuqukethwe okwephula umthetho, i-copyright, noma ubumfihlo babanye.
  • Ukusebenzisa le sevisi ukwephula ukuvikelwa kwekhophi (DRM) noma eminye imikhawulo yezobuchwepheshe.
  • Ukusebenzisa ama-bot, ama-script, noma okuzenzakalelayo ukufinyelela isevisi ngobuningi.
  • Ukuphazamisa, ukuthwalisa kanzima, noma ukuzama ukwephula ukuphepha kwewebhusayithi namasevisi ethu.

Imiphumela yokuguqula

Sizama ukwenza imiphumela yokuguqula ibe mihle ngangokunokwenzeka, kodwa akuzona zonke izifomethi ezingaguqulwa ngokuphelele. Ukwakheka kwekhasi, izithombe, amathebula, amafomula, i-metadata, noma ikhwalithi kungashintsha noma kulahleke, kuya ngefomethi yokuqala neyokugcina. Hlola imiphumela ngaphambi kokuyisebenzisela izinto ezibalulekile.

Ukutholakala kwesevisi

Isevisi inikezwa mahhala futhi ingashintshwa, ikhawulwe, noma imiswe noma nini ngaphandle kwesaziso. Ezinye izifomethi zincike emandleni esiphequluli nedivayisi yakho, ngakho akukhona konke ukuguqula okutholakala njalo.

Isaziso sokuzihlukanisa

Isevisi inikezwa "njengoba injalo" futhi "njengoba itholakala", ngaphandle kwanoma yisiphi isiqinisekiso, okuhlanganisa isiqinisekiso sokuthi isevisi izohlala isebenza, ingenamaphutha, noma ifanele inhloso ethile.

Umkhawulo womthwalo

Ngezinga elivunyelwe ngumthetho, asinamthwalo wanoma yikuphi ukulahlekelwa okuqondile noma okungaqondile okubangelwa ukusetshenziswa kwale sevisi, okuhlanganisa ukulahleka noma ukonakala kwedatha namafayela.

Izixhumanisi eziya kwabangaphandle

Le webhusayithi iqukethe izixhumanisi eziya kumasayithi namasevisi ezinkampani zangaphandle. Asinamthwalo wokuqukethwe noma wezinqubomgomo zalawo masayithi.

Izinguquko emigomeni

Le migomo nemibandela ingabuyekezwa noma nini. Ngokuqhubeka usebenzisa isevisi ngemva kokushicilelwa kwezinguquko, uthathwa njengovumelana nenguqulo yakamuva.

Umthetho olawulayo

Le migomo nemibandela ilawulwa yimithetho yeRiphabhulikhi yase-Indonesia.

Xhumana nathi

Imibuzo nemibiko ingathunyelwa ngesixhumanisi sokuxhumana esingezansi kwekhasi ngalinye noma nge-abidhanan.my.id. Funda futhi Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo yethu.
